documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on July 16, 2026, reporting strong financial and operational performance with robust revenue, EBITDA, and profit growth. Management highlighted record quarterly production across solar modules and cells, an expanded order book of 9.9 gigawatt, and steady progress on their 6-gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion. The company also discussed the implementation of ALMM List 2, stable margins, and medium-term plans for backward integration into ingot and wafer manufacturing. Emmvee Photovoltaic reported a strong record quarterly performance for Q1 FY27 with revenue reaching INR 15,555 million and EBITDA expanding to INR 5,481 million. Management highlighted robust order inflows of 1,484 MW during the quarter, bringing the total order book to 9.9 GW and providing strong revenue visibility for coming quarters.

guidance.claim: Management targets approximately INR 2,400 crore of EBITDA by the close of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of an EBITDA by the close of FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach total installed capacities of 16.3 gigawatts for modules and 8.9 gigawatts for cells by the end of FY2027.
guidance.quote: Once completed, this will take our total installed capacity to 16.3 gigawatt for modules and 8.9 gigawatt for cells by the end of FY2027 financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the order book provides healthy revenue visibility and reflects continued demand across utility-scale, commercial and industrial, and rooftop solar segments.
demand_outlook.quote: The order book provides healthy revenue visibility and reflects continued demand across utility-scale, commercial and industrial, and rooftop solar segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company reported that order inflow for Q1FY27 was 1,484 MW, reinforcing demand momentum.
Domestic cell supply remains tight, especially for TOPCon cells, supporting the margin environment for established manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic cell supply remains tight, especially for TOPCon cells.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand outlook for a manufacturer like them has been strong.
demand_outlook.quote: So the demand outlook for a manufacturer like us has been strong.

demand_outlook.claim: C&I has consistently been the fastest-growing sector for a long time and is similarly growing in the company's case.
demand_outlook.quote: And C&I has always been the fastest-growing sector in a long time, which you can see is similarly growing in our case as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that DCR module pricing is about INR 21 to INR 22 per watt and module is around INR 14 to INR 15 per watt.
demand_outlook.quote: So, for DCR module, it is about INR21 to INR22 on a watt, and module is around like INR14 to INR15 per watt.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 6-gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion is progressing according to plan.
capex_expansion.quote: Our ongoing 6 gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion continue to progress according to plan.

capex_expansion.claim: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the 6-gigawatt facility is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at the cost of less than 8% for the expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at the cost of less than 8%.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed ingot and wafer facility will have a total capacity of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.
capex_expansion.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.

capex_expansion.claim: The company initiated plans for a new 6 gigawatt integrated cell and module manufacturing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: We have initiated plans for our new 6 gigawatt integrated cell and module manufacturing facility.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects the module line of the 6 gigawatt expansion to be commissioned by the end of the calendar year and the cell line by the end of the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: and we expect to see the module line getting commissioned by the end of this calendar year and the cell line getting commissioned at the end of this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company intends to set up an ingot and wafer facility of about 9 gigawatts in phases, with the first facility planned for FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: And with that, we intend to set up an ingot and wafer facility of about 9 gigawatt integrating us fully in phases. And we plan to set up our first facility in FY29.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the wafer and ingot expansion is planned for a 5 gigawatt capacity, followed by a 4 gigawatt expansion in Phase 2 a year later.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with the expansion, we’re looking at a 5 gigawatt expansion in Phase 1 and a 4 gigawatt expansion in Phase 2, which is going to be a year after.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1FY2027 improved to 35% compared to 34% in Q1FY26 and 33% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: An EBITDA margin improved to 35% compared to 34% in Q1FY26 and 33% in Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax margin improved to 24% compared to 18% in the corresponding quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 24% compared to 18% in the corresponding quarter last year and 23% in the previous quarter, due to lower finance costs that reduced significantly to INR 11.1 crores compared to INR 53.1 crores in Q1FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded to 34% in FY2026 compared to 31% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded to 34% compared to 31% in the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin improved to 21% in FY2026 compared to 16% in FY2025.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 21% compared to 16% in FY2025.

margins_costs.claim: Management secured a competitive interest rate of 7.95% on the IREDA term loan.
margins_costs.quote: So, currently, the rate is 7.95%. Earlier the rate was higher, but with the current market trend and the offers we’re getting from other banks, so we got a very competitive rate of 7.95% now.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book further strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt, supported by fresh order inflows of approximately 1.5 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book further strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt, supported by fresh order inflows and approximately 1.5 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Solar module production stood at 970 megawatt and solar cell production increased to 454 megawatt in Q1FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Solar module production stood at 970 megawatt compared to 635 megawatt in Q1FY26 and 952 megawatt in Q4 FY26. This represents year-on-year growth of 53%. Solar cell production increased to 454 megawatt compared to 360 megawatt in Q1FY26 and 428 megawatt in Q4 FY26, representing year-on-year growth of 26%.

orders_capacity.claim: Current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.

orders_capacity.claim: Emmvee closed the financial year with an order book of 9.4 gigawatts.
orders_capacity.quote: We closed the financial year with revenue of INR 5,049 crores, EBITDA of INR 1,734 crores, PAT of INR 1,082 crores and an order book of 9.4 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed solar module capacity increased to 10.3 gigawatts as of March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our installed solar module capacity increased to 10.3 gigawatt as of March 31, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: Solar cell installed capacity stood at 2.94 gigawatts as of March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our solar cell installed capacity stood at 2.94 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Solar cell capacity utilization increased from 43.3% in FY2025 to 69.9% in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Solar cell capacity utilization increased from 43.3% in FY2025 to 69.9% in FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Order inflow for Q4 FY2026 stood at 1.27 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: For Q4 FY26, order inflow stood at 1.27 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: The average order size among the top 10 customers increased to 221 megawatts in FY26 compared to 121 megawatts in FY25.
orders_capacity.quote: The average order size among the top 10 customers increased to 221 megawatt in FY26 compared to 121 megawatt in FY25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised INR 2,900 crores through its IPO and public listing in November 2025, including INR 2,144 crores of fresh issue proceeds.
capital_allocation.quote: We completed our IPO and public listing in November 2025, raising INR2,900 crores, including INR2,144 crores of fresh issue proceeds.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately INR 1,621 crores of IPO proceeds were used to prepay term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: We used approximately INR1,621 crores of IPO proceeds to prepay term loans.

capital_allocation.claim: IREDA sanctioned a term loan of INR 3,306 crores for the 6 gigawatt integrated facility.
capital_allocation.quote: IREDA has sanctioned our term loan for INR3,306 crores for this facility.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells continues to remain relatively tight.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells continues to remain relatively tight, which should support the operating environment for established and compliant cell manufacturers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that competition will increase, technology will evolve, trade rules will change, and logistic and commodity cycles may remain volatile.
risks_headwinds.quote: Competition will increase, technology will evolve, trade rules will change, logistic and commodity cycles may remain volatile.

management_commitments.claim: The module line of the 6-gigawatt facility is expected to be commissioned by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Following the completion of this expansion, our total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to commission the module line of the new 6 gigawatt facility by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: we expect to see the module line getting commissioned by the end of this calendar year and the cell line getting commissioned at the end of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to set up its first ingot and wafer facility in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And we plan to set up our first facility in FY29.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
